summary: There's a part of you that knows deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe and a fast, restless mind grind against each other inside you. That friction is the engine you run on. Pushed, your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need. Owned, you read people and care on instinct and you think and talk your way through anything.
body: There's a part of you that knows deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe and a fast, restless mind grind against each other inside you. That friction is the engine you run on. Pushed, your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need. Owned, you read people and care on instinct and you think and talk your way through anything. Communication colored by mood; powerful when feeling and reasoning are integrated. Feelings may need language here, but language may not always keep pace with emotion. This can make it important to notice what is being felt before it becomes something to explain.
gift: At your best: you read people and care on instinct, and you think and talk your way through anything.
shadow: The trap: your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need — or you overthink it, or talk when you should feel.
integration: Let emotional needs and thinking and speech cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Communication colored by mood; powerful when feeling and reasoning are integrated.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you read people and you think work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
